findings.issue: Circular dependency between tasks violates the acyclic dependency requirement.
findings.evidence: T1 'add nullable column migration', after=[T3]; T2 'extend API DTO and generated shared Order contract', after=[T1]; T3 'regenerate migration snapshot after DTO update', after=[T2]
findings.failure_scenario: The cycle T1 -> T2 -> T3 -> T1 creates a scheduling deadlock, preventing any of the three tasks from starting.
findings.fix: Remove T3 from T1's after list so T1 can execute as the root migration task.

findings.issue: Concurrent modification of shared contract file without an explicit dependency path or named merge owner.
findings.evidence: T2 writes=[apps/api/order-dto.ts,packages/contracts/order.ts]; T4 writes=[apps/web/order-client.ts,packages/contracts/order.ts], resources=[order-contract]. No merge owner exists.
findings.failure_scenario: T2 and T4 both run concurrently after T1 and modify packages/contracts/order.ts, leading to merge conflicts or contract divergence between API and client.
findings.fix: Set T4 after=[T2] to enforce an explicit dependency path (or designate a named merge owner) and have T4 consume the generated contract rather than independently patching it.

findings.issue: Verification command short-circuits on error, preventing execution and exit status recording of subsequent checks.
findings.evidence: command='npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit'; acceptance='record the exit status of all three checks, including if lint fails'
findings.failure_scenario: If lint fails, the '&&' operator terminates the process immediately, skipping typecheck and unit tests and leaving their exit statuses unrecorded.
findings.fix: Update the command script to run each check independently regardless of earlier failures, capture each exit code, and record all three exit statuses.
